Artificial intelligence is more a part of our lives than ever before. While some might call it hype and compare it to NFTs or 3D TVs, generative AI is causing a sea change in nearly every part of the technology industry. OpenAI’s ChatGPT is still the best-known AI chatbot around, but with Google pushing Gemini, Microsoft building Copilot, and Apple adding its Intelligence to Siri, AI is probably going to be in the spotlight for a very long time. At The Verge, we’re exploring what might be possible with AI — and a lot of the bad stuff AI does, too.

- RELATED /

The AI Workmate Concept can scan documents, project presentations, or just keep you company in the office.
Andrew LiszewskiMar 1

Anthropic says it will challenge the designation in court.
Tina NguyenFeb 28

T

Terrence O'BrienMar 1

The US used Anthropic AI for strikes in Iran despite ban.
On Friday, Donald Trump [announced a ban](/policy/886489/pentagon-anthropic-trump-dod) on the [federal government’s use](/policy/886632/pentagon-designates-anthropic-supply-chain-risk-ai-standoff) of Claude. Though he had to walk back his demand that agencies “IMMEDIATELY CEASE” using it, instead saying there would be a [six-month phaseout](https://www.npr.org/2026/02/27/nx-s1-5729118/trump-anthropic-pentagon-openai-ai-weapons-ban). Part of that might be because planning for Saturday’s strikes against Iran was underway and [relied on Claude](/ai-artificial-intelligence/883456/anthropic-pentagon-department-of-defense-negotiations) for intelligence assessments and target identification. According to the [Wall Street Journal](https://www.wsj.com/livecoverage/iran-strikes-2026/card/u-s-strikes-in-middle-east-use-anthropic-hours-after-trump-ban-ozNO0iClZpfpL7K7ElJ2):
Within hours of declaring that the federal government will end its use of artificial-intelligence tools made by tech company Anthropic, President Trump launched a major air attack in Iran with the help of those very same tools.

T

Terrence O'BrienFeb 28

A former Trump advisor calls the fight with Anthropic “attempted corporate murder.”
Dean Ball, who worked as a senior AI policy advisor, [said on X](https://x.com/deanwball/status/2027515599358730315?s=20) that designating Anthropic as a “[supply chain risk](/policy/886632/pentagon-designates-anthropic-supply-chain-risk-ai-standoff)” or threatening to invoke the [Defense Production Act](/policy/886489/pentagon-anthropic-trump-dod) could have a chilling effect on the entire industry. Alan Rozenshtein, a former DOJ official specializing in technology law, told [Politico](https://www.politico.com/news/2026/02/27/ai-industry-fears-partial-nationalization-as-anthropic-fight-escalates-00805453) this could be the first step toward partial nationalization of the AI industry.

H

Hayden FieldFeb 28

OpenAI reached a new agreement with the Pentagon.
CEO Sam Altman [wrote](https://x.com/sama/status/2027578652477821175?s=20) on X that the agreement allowed the US military to “deploy our models in their classified network.” He said the agreement reflects OpenAI’s desire for prohibitions on domestic mass surveillance and “human responsibility for the use of force, including for autonomous weapon systems.” Altman also wrote that OpenAI is “asking the DoW to offer these same terms to all AI companies, which in our opinion we think everyone should be willing to accept.” This follows a [rollercoaster week of negotiations](/ai-artificial-intelligence/885963/anthropic-dod-pentagon-tech-workers-ai-labs-react) between Anthropic and the Pentagon.

Hayden Field and Richard LawlerFeb 27

H

Hayden FieldFeb 27

Even Ilya Sutskever weighed in on the Anthropic-Pentagon situation.
The OpenAI co-founder, who left after CEO Sam Altman’s ouster and reinstatement and then started his own AI startup called Safe Superintelligence, [posted](https://x.com/ilyasut/status/2027486969174102261?s=46&t=fRkDIqgNCkTkvg8ZBiLA9A) on X:
It’s extremely good that Anthropic has not backed down, and it’s siginficant that OpenAI has taken a similar stance.
In the future, there will be much more challenging situations of this nature, and it will be critical for the relevant leaders to rise up to the occasion, for fierce competitors to put their differences aside. Good to see that happen today.

Stevie BonifieldMar 1

AI companies could stand together to draw red lines on military AI — why aren’t they?
Hayden FieldFeb 27

David PierceFeb 27

Terrence O'BrienFeb 27

T

Thomas RickerFeb 27

OpenAI would have alerted police to Canadian shooter if account was discovered today.
That’s the takeaway from Altman and Co’s [new safety protocols](https://cdn.openai.com/pdf/8e938d69-0b67-4994-b9ff-683733ed587e/openai-letter-minister-solomon.pdf) that govern when to involve law enforcement. The changes come after a fatal shooting at a school in Tumbler Ridge, British Columbia. this month that killed eight and left dozens injured.
The suspect’s interactions with ChatGPT suggested the possibility of real-world violence and [led OpenAI to shut down the account](http://s), but not notify police.

Hayden FieldFeb 26

Emma RothFeb 26

Stevie BonifieldFeb 26

Google Translate is using Gemini AI to offer alternative translations based on context.
Users can also ask the AI for more context with new “Understand” and “Ask” buttons.

Image: Google

Jay PetersFeb 26

Terrence O'BrienFeb 26

Jess WeatherbedFeb 26

T

Tina NguyenFeb 26

Robert HartFeb 26

J

Jess WeatherbedFeb 26

YouTube’s algorithm loves feeding AI slop to kids.
After watching popular children’s channels like CoComelon, Bluey, or Ms. Rachel, The New York Times found that more than 40 percent of Shorts recommended by the platform “appeared to contain AI-generated visuals.” YouTube doesn’t require animated AI videos for children [to be labeled](/ai-artificial-intelligence/882956/ai-deepfake-detection-labels-c2pa-instagram-youtube), placing all [moderation burdens on parents](/tech/824556/youtube-kids-videos-slop) instead.

D

Dominic PrestonFeb 26

The new new.
David Luan, head of Amazon’s San Francisco AGI lab, is [leaving to work on something new](/tech/884372/amazon-agi-lab-leader-david-luan-departure). Newer than AGI, that is, which is saying something considering that’s still nonexistent.

Perplexity’s “Computer” is full of AI agents.
It says the [new platform](https://www.perplexity.ai/hub/blog/introducing-perplexity-computer) “reasons, delegates, searches, builds, remembers, codes, and delivers,” across sub AI agents, creating what Perplexity calls a “general-purpose digital worker” that exists somewhere between [OpenClaw](/news/872091/openclaw-moltbot-clawdbot-ai-agent-news) and [Claude Cowork](/ai-artificial-intelligence/883707/anthropic-claude-cowork-updates).

# 今日AI要闻 | 2026年3月2日

## 📰 热点头条

### 1. OpenAI 与五角大楼达成模型部署协议
- **核心内容**：OpenAI CEO Sam Altman 宣布与美国军方达成协议，允许美国军方在其机密网络中部署 OpenAI 模型。
- **关键表态**：Altman 表示 OpenAI 禁止国内大规模监控，并强调"人类对武力使用的责任"，包括自主武器系统。
- **行业呼吁**：OpenAI 要求国防部向所有AI公司提供相同条款，认为所有公司都应愿意接受。
- **来源**：The Verge / OpenAI 官方声明

---

### 2. Anthropic 被五角大楼列为"供应链风险"
- **事件背景**：特朗普宣布禁止联邦政府使用 Anthropic 的 Claude 产品，随后将禁令改为6个月逐步停用。
- **争议焦点**：五角大楼对伊朗的空袭行动在禁令发布数小时后仍使用了 Claude 进行情报评估和目标识别。
- **行业反应**：前特朗普AI政策顾问 Dean Ball 称此举为"试图企业谋杀"，可能对整个AI行业产生寒蝉效应。
- **专家观点**：前司法部技术法专家 Alan Rozenshtein 表示这可能是AI行业部分国有化的第一步。
- **来源**：The Verge / Wall Street Journal

---

### 3. Ilya Sutskever 评论 Anthropic-五角大楼事件
- **人物背景**：OpenAI 联合创始人，后创办 Safe Superintelligence。
- **核心观点**：
  - Anthropic 没有退让"非常好"
  - OpenAI 采取类似立场"意义重大"
  - 未来将面临更具挑战性的类似情况
  - 竞争对手放下分歧至关重要
- **来源**：Ilya Sutskever X/Twitter

---

### 4. OpenAI 发布新的安全协议
- **背景**：加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省 Tumbler Ridge 学校枪击事件（8人死亡，数十人受伤）。
- **新规内容**：
  - 若发现 ChatGPT 账户涉及现实世界暴力可能性，将通知执法部门
  - 在此前的枪击案中，嫌疑人的 ChatGPT 互动引起了警觉，但当时 OpenAI 仅关闭账户而未报警
- **表态**：若在今天的政策下发现该账户，OpenAI 会向警方报告。
- **来源**：The Verge / OpenAI 官方信函

---

### 5. 机器之心 Week 09 会员通讯要点
- **Kimi 与 Minimax 分别发布「Claw」产品**
- **Anthropic 收购视觉 AI 创企 Vercept**
- **谷歌 Gemini 大模型升级至 3.1 Pro 版本**
- **来源**：机器之心会员通讯

---

### 6. Perplexity 发布 "Computer" AI 代理平台
- **产品定位**："通用数字工作者"，介于 OpenClaw 与 Claude Cowork 之间。
- **核心能力**：推理、委派、搜索、构建、记忆、编码和交付。
- **技术架构**：由多个子AI代理协同工作。
- **来源**：Perplexity 官方博客 / The Verge

---

### 7. Google Translate 集成 Gemini AI
- **新功能**：
  - 根据上下文提供替代翻译
  - 新增"理解"和"询问"按钮，可向 AI 请求更多上下文信息
- **来源**：The Verge

---

### 8. YouTube 算法向儿童推送 AI 生成内容
- **调查发现**：《纽约时报》发现，在观看 CoComelon、Bluey、Ms. Rachel 等热门儿童频道后，YouTube Shorts 推荐内容中超过 40% 包含 AI 生成视觉效果。
- **问题所在**：YouTube 不要求儿童动画 AI 视频标注，将审核责任推给家长。
- **来源**：The New York Times / The Verge

---

### 9. Amazon AGI 实验室负责人离职
- **人物**：David Luan，Amazon 旧金山 AGI 实验室负责人。
- **去向**：将致力于"比 AGI 更新的东西"。
- **背景**：AGI 目前尚未实现。
- **来源**：The Verge

---

## 📊 今日要点总结

| 领域 | 关键动态 |
|------|----------|
| 🏛️ 政策与监管 | 美国政府与AI公司之间的紧张关系升级，Anthropic 被列为风险，OpenAI 与军方达成合作 |
| 🚀 产品发布 | Perplexity Computer、Kimi/Minimax Claw、Gemini 翻译升级 |
| 🛡️ 安全与伦理 | OpenAI 更新安全协议，强调对暴力内容的执法通知义务 |
| 🤝 行业动态 | AI 巨头在军事AI使用边界问题上开始形成某种共识 |

---
